changelog.message: op created to filter an object of objects by a nested key value
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Filters a dictionary of child objects by matching a nested property key against one or more allowed values.

ports.name: In Object
ports.text: The object of objects to filter (for example, a client's `manifest.parameters` object).

ports.name: Filter Key
ports.text: The property key inside each child object to inspect (e.g., `type` or `group`). Supports dot notation.

ports.name: Filter Values
ports.text: Comma-separated list of values to match against `child[Filter Key]` (e.g., `float,int,boolean`).

ports.name: Filter Values Array
ports.text: Optional array of values to match; overrides `Filter Values` string when linked.

ports.name: Mode
ports.text: `Include Matching` keeps entries whose `Filter Key` value is in `Filter Values`; `Exclude Matching` removes them.

ports.name: Case Sensitive
ports.text: When false (default), value comparisons are case-insensitive.

ports.name: Filtered Object
ports.text: A new object containing only the matching top-level keys and child objects.

ports.name: Filtered Keys
ports.text: Ordered array of top-level keys that matched the filter criteria.

ports.name: Filtered Values
ports.text: Ordered array of child objects corresponding 1:1 with `Filtered Keys`.
